name: Disneyland Café Daisy (Toontown) "Goody-Goody" Mini Corn Dogs & Applesauce
searchKeywords: goody goody mini corn dogs toontown
whyItWorks: Bite-sized mini corn dogs give you a much smaller, lighter portion of fried cornmeal batter than a giant wagon corn dog, paired with smooth applesauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with smooth applesauce or plain potato bites (give away any cutaneous Mandarin Orange pack).
watchOuts: Fried cornmeal batter—blot any excess oil with a napkin
